Attached: CloudWare_W9.pdf and a preliminary Security questionnaire with answers (CloudWare_Security_QA.docx). We can also sign a standard MSA if that’s required — Contracts will push a DocuSign if you prefer.

A few specifics from our procurement team:
- Billing entity/legal name: CloudWare Solutions, Inc.
- Tax ID / EIN: 12-3456789 (will reattach certified W-9)
- Preferred billing email for invoices: finance@cloudware.com
- Do you accept Marketplace-billed POs (invoiced through AWS/Azure/GCP) or do you need us to send a Redwood PO directly?

We’d like to avoid delays — can you confirm a checklist and any forms you’ll need back (vendor intake, tax certs, SOC 2 or equivalent)? If there’s a different contact to route to, please direct me.

Thanks,
Katie Rogers
Procurement Lead | CloudWare Solutions
procurement@cloudware.com

From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai

Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, soojin.lee@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 18:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor activation + PO routing for Redwood listing

Hi Katie — thanks, and welcome. I’m copying Finance (Vanessa), BillingOps (Ben) and Legal (Soojin) to make sure we cover all lanes. Short version up front: we support both Marketplace-billed and Direct Vendor (NetSuite) PO flows, but the onboarding artifacts differ by lane and timing. See the checklist below and the requested next steps so we don’t block your go-live.

Redwood onboarding checklist (what we need from CloudWare)
- Completed Redwood vendor intake form (I’ve asked Ben to send the PDF)
- Signed W-9 (attached is fine) and legal entity name + address
- Seller Marketplace ID (for AWS/Azure/GCP) — if you list via a marketplace, invoices typically route through the marketplace and we reconcile on our side
- SOC 2 / security evidence (or self-attested questionnaire + SOC roadmap) — Soojin will confirm the minimum evidence we need
- MSA/DocuSign: If you prefer to use your contract, Legal will review. For many marketplace customers the marketplace T&Cs cover commercial terms and we accept marketplace invoicing.

Marketplace vs Direct Vendor lanes (high level)
- Marketplace-billed (recommended if you list through AWS/Azure/GCP): Redwood receives invoices via marketplace billing (we reconcile and process via our marketplace payables lane) — less NetSuite overhead on our side, faster payment cadence (typically 30-45 days depending on marketplace). You must provide Seller ID and marketplace billing contact.
- Direct Vendor PO (NetSuite vendor creation): We create a Redwood vendor record and you send invoices directly to Redwood AP (invoices@redwood.ai). This lane requires the vendor intake form, W-9, remittance address, invoice sample, and our vendor setup ticket before the first payment.

Requested next steps
1) Katie — please confirm whether CloudWare will invoice via marketplace billing or as a direct vendor. If marketplace, share Seller IDs and marketplace billing contact.
2) Ben — please send the vendor intake PDF to CloudWare and create the NetSuite intake ticket (if they choose Direct Vendor).
3) Soojin — can Legal confirm required redlines for CloudWare MSA if they push their contract?
4) Vanessa — confirm Redwood’s default net terms for marketplace vs direct vendor and flag any exceptions (e.g., cadence for first invoice).

If helpful I can put together a very short mutual action plan + timeline (1–2 week target for onboarding if docs are complete).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0112

--
Attachment reference: CloudWare_W9.pdf, CloudWare_Security_QA.docx

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

Thanks Kim / Katie — quick finance note: our default net terms for marketplace-billed invoices are Net 45 (marketplace reconciliation can add a short delay on first payment). For direct vendor invoices we typically do Net 30 after vendor creation. If CloudWare requires a different term for the first invoice, flag it now and we can route an exception to FP&A.

Also need confirmed Tax ID and the legal remittance address to start the vendor record (if they go direct). Katie — can you confirm whether CloudWare needs advance notice for PO acceptance or whether standard electronic invoice submission is fine?

Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
